llm_judge_details.justification: The topology includes all core VNFs needed for office broadband (completeness good) but adds many extra functions not required for a simple use case. VNF types are correct, yet the listed interface protocols (HTTP for N1/N2/N3 etc.) and some connections do not follow 3GPP specifications, leading to major correctness issues. Resource requests are modest and roughly match a 20‑user scenario, so resource sizing is appropriate. The chosen eMBB slice (SST=1) aligns well with the intent. SLA targets (20 ms latency, 1 Gbps throughput, 99.9% availability) are reasonable for fast office internet.
